rules.details: Unless the background is light grey, prefer white for better consistency.

rules.summary: Use dark text on light grey backgrounds.
rules.details: Light grey backgrounds should use dark text for readability.

rules.summary: Avoid green text on yellow background.
rules.details: Green on yellow reduces legibility; prefer dark grey.

rules.summary: Use WCAG luminance contrast as the primary gatekeeper.
rules.details: Compute relative luminance and contrast ratio by size tier; enforce polarity (bg vs text luminance) and block mid-tone pairings to ensure legibility.

rules.summary: Footer small print must span the full width.
rules.details: Require 1vw inset on each side and 1vh offset from the bottom edge.

rules.summary: Place logo/headline/small print by size tier.
rules.details: Vertical: logo in top 15% (centered), headline in next 35%, small print in bottom 15%. Horizontal: logo left-top quadrant, headline centered in middle band, small print bottom band. Large: allow larger headline zone; Small: tighten headline zone to avoid overflow.
